Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ c9a6f6767dba599a532bf1708d6d46c37f06637e

Verdict FINDINGS

1. crates/app/src/project/tool_body_wire.rs:181 — The loader checks piece facet counts but not coordinates. A same-count corrupted piece is accepted. In a standalone repro, scaling piece 0 XY coordinates by 0.1 loaded successfully; removing piece 1 then shrank the retained body's collision radius from 14.142 mm to 1.414 mm. Validate that piece geometry equals the combined mesh, or derive one canonical mesh.
2. crates/ui/src/state_tool_body_assembly.rs:33 — The editor always passes target_piece=None. After head and adapter both carry MCS, attaching a third piece with target MCS and piece CSW fails as ambiguous. The same repro succeeds with target_piece=1. Expose the target piece selector.
3. crates/ui/src/state.rs:298 — The PR grows files already over the AGENTS.md ~400-line limit: state.rs 4467→4489, schema.rs 720→724, egui_app/tests.rs 5308→5309. No applicable exemption was found.

Checks:
- Named app suites: 35 passed. Named UI assembly suite: 2 passed.
- cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: RED. App suites passed. Two GPU tests failed because Metal found no graphics adapters: egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds (crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1898) and headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero (crates/ui/tests/shell.rs:12). This environment cannot establish a green gate.
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings: GREEN.
- No added production unwrap/expect/panic. No changed golden lines. No PR changes to snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo dependencies, .github, or scripts. Body has Changelog: and Fixes #361.
- Mutation results below use the four app assembly pins. RED means the pin caught the bypass; GREEN means it survived. No compile failures. All temporary edits restored; restored assembly suite passed 4/4. Worktree diff was empty.

Mutations RED: serialization, ambiguous_auto, single_piece_removal, remove_bounds, spindle_frame_mismatch, missing_target_name.

Mutations GREEN: lathe_frame_mismatch, spun_refusal, empty_assembly, csys_empty_name, csys_nonfinite_origin, spindle_invalid_axis, spindle_invalid_offset, target_piece_bounds, incoming_no_csys, target_no_csys, missing_piece_name, dto_count, csys_invalid_z, csys_invalid_x, attach_loaded_piece_missing_entity, attach_loaded_piece_not_tool, attach_loaded_piece_fits, attach_loaded_piece_no_body, remove_piece_missing_entity, remove_piece_not_tool, remove_piece_fits, remove_piece_no_body, find_target_by_name_ambiguity, find_piece_by_name_ambiguity, find_complementary_target_ambiguity, find_complementary_piece_ambiguity, find_complementary_target_missing, find_complementary_piece_missing.

Needs changes before merge.

The assembly commands support undo. The new tests check persistence, collision refusal, and piece removal. The trial merge with upstream/main was clean.

Local checks used upstream/main at 703af8185f7cfc574050d0187502b4b42d6b67eb in a separate worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. App: 1,437 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored across 124 test binaries. UI: 894 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored across 12 test binaries. The gate took 9.3 minutes. The UI tests ran from `crates/ui`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Safety mutation 1: omit `pieces` from serialization. The persistence test failed at `crates/app/tests/tool_body_assembly.rs:214`: piece count was 1, expected 3. RED: the test detected the change.
- Safety mutation 2: bypass the single-piece removal guard. The refusal test failed at `crates/app/tests/tool_body_assembly.rs:257`: the error changed to `tool body assembly has no pieces`. RED: the test detected the change.
- Both mutations were removed. The restored assembly suite passed 4/4. All temporary test changes were removed. The worktree diff was empty.
- No goldens or snapshot PNGs changed. There were no changed golden lines to check.

Requested before merge:

1. **Safety: validate the saved piece coordinates.** `crates/app/src/project/tool_body_wire.rs:181` checks only the total facet count. It accepts piece coordinates that differ from the combined body. I scaled the saved XY coordinates of piece 0 by 0.1 without changing its facet count. The loader accepted the file and kept the original combined mesh. After removal of piece 1, the collision radius of the retained head changed from 14.1421366 mm to 1.4142146 mm. An attachment also rebuilds the body from these unchecked pieces. Validate that the piece meshes equal the combined mesh, or use one validated mesh as the source for both. Add a test that refuses inconsistent saved geometry.
2. **Add a target-piece control to the editor.** `crates/ui/src/state_tool_body_assembly.rs:33` always sets `target_piece` to `None`. After the head and adapter each have an `MCS`, attachment of a third piece with target `MCS` and piece `CSW` fails as ambiguous. I repeated this case: the same attachment succeeds with `target_piece: Some(1)`. Add a piece selector and pass its index to the command. Add a UI test for three pieces with repeated CSYS names.
3. **Add before and after UI screenshots to the PR body.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_assembly_page.rs:14` adds assembly controls. The PR body has no screenshots. Show the editor before this change and with the new controls and an assembled tool. Keep release snapshot PNGs out of the diff.

Non-blocking note: this PR adds lines to large files, including `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `crates/app/src/schema.rs`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. Use smaller modules when practical, as required by the code-shape rule.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed the three requested changes from the latest review.

1. Saved pieces must now exactly match the validated combined mesh. `inconsistent_saved_piece_coordinates_are_refused_in_camproj_and_camtools` pins same-count coordinate corruption in both formats. Bypassing validation made the pin RED. Restoring it made the assembly suite GREEN (5/5).
2. The editor now has a target-piece selector and passes its index to attachment. `editor_selects_target_piece_when_three_pieces_repeat_csys_names` clicks the selector and attaches a third piece with repeated CSYS names. Dropping the index and wiring the wrong index each made the pin RED. Restoring both made the UI assembly suite GREEN (3/3).
3. The PR body now shows actual before and after editor screenshots, including the assembled tool and selected target piece. Both capture runs passed. Temporary capture code was removed. Release snapshots were unchanged.

New head: 26f9eae18db9aff52af19fbad7e3bd61723fa533.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN. App: 1,436 passed. UI: 890 passed. Zero failures.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.

The trial merge with current upstream/main was clean. The PR remains a draft. Please re-review this head.

Needs changes before merge.

The three previous requested changes are complete. Saved piece coordinates must match the validated combined mesh. The editor has a target-piece selector. The PR body has before and after screenshots that show the editor and assembled tool.

Local checks used a clean trial merge with upstream/main at ebda4f2f. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS in 10.2 minutes. App: 1,454 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored across 126 test binaries. UI: 910 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored across 12 test binaries. UI checks ran from `crates/ui`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: FAIL. The errors are in unchanged upstream code, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:12` and `:40`:

```text
error: constant `PNG_256` is never used
error: function `taskbar_icon` is never used
```

This Linux clippy failure is separate from the requested PR change below.

Safety mutation checks:

- Omit piece serialization: RED. The persistence test failed at `crates/app/tests/tool_body_assembly.rs:214`: piece count was 1, expected 3.
- Bypass the saved-coordinate equality check: RED. The corrupt-project refusal test failed at `crates/app/tests/tool_body_assembly.rs:342` because the loader accepted the corrupt project.
- After restoration, the app assembly suite passed 5/5. No goldens changed, so there were no changed golden lines to check.

Requested before merge:

1. **Keep modular pieces when the user applies the existing body.** `crates/ui/src/state_tool_body.rs:322` builds a new single-piece body from the combined facets. The draft at line 154 keeps only the first piece's coordinate systems. In a temporary UI test, I imported the head, clicked `Apply body`, attached the clamp, checked that there were two pieces, then clicked `Apply body` without changing any fields. The piece count became 1, expected 2. This removes the separate piece records and the adapter's coordinate systems. The user can no longer remove that adapter or select it as a mating target. Keep each piece and its coordinate systems when applying an assembly. If the placement changes, transform all pieces together. Add a UI test for an unchanged apply and for a placement change.

The temporary UI test failed with:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed: Apply body must retain modular pieces
  left: 1
 right: 2
```

All temporary mutations and the temporary test were removed. The restored UI assembly suite passed 3/3. The worktree diff was empty.

Non-blocking note: this PR adds lines to large files, including `state.rs`, `schema.rs`, and `egui_app/tests.rs`. Use smaller modules when practical.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the latest review finding. Apply body now retains every modular piece and its coordinate systems. Placement changes transform all pieces together. The command still validates the combined geometry and tool fit.

Pins:
- `editor_unchanged_apply_retains_modular_pieces_and_csys` checks unchanged apply, piece removal, undo, and replacement import for spindle and lathe assemblies.
- `editor_placement_apply_transforms_all_modular_pieces_and_csys` checks placement changes to every piece mesh and coordinate system, and undo.

Bypassing spindle preservation, lathe preservation, or coordinate-system transformation each made the pins RED. Restoring the fix made the assembly suite GREEN (5/5).

I checked the before and after screenshots in the PR body.

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: FAIL on two errors in unchanged upstream code. The file is identical to upstream/main. These errors are a limit of this validation, not a requested PR change:

error: constant `PNG_256` is never used

1. Omit piece serialization: RED. The persistence test failed at `crates/app/tests/tool_body_assembly.rs:214`. The piece count was 1, expected 3.
2. Bypass saved-coordinate validation: RED. The corrupt-project test failed at `crates/app/tests/tool_body_assembly.rs:342`. The loader accepted the corrupt project.

Both mutations were removed. The restored app assembly suite passed 5/5. The worktree had no file changes after restoration. No goldens changed, so there were no changed golden lines to check. No release snapshot PNGs changed.
